title: Start a German course towards B1
why: Many English-taught programmes don't require German, but B1 makes daily life, a part-time job and the visa process much easier.

title: Shortlist universities and programmes
why: Admission requirements and deadlines differ per programme, so everything else depends on this list.

title: Book your German or English language exam
why: Exam slots fill up weeks ahead, and many universities want the certificate at application time.

title: Start your APS certificate
why: Required for Indian applicants, and processing can take weeks.

title: Collect transcripts, degree certificate and recommendation letters
why: University offices and professors are slow, so start early.

title: Submit applications
why: Most winter-intake deadlines fall around this window, but check each university's exact date.

title: Open a blocked account
why: Proof of funds is required for the student visa.

title: Book your visa appointment
why: Appointment waiting times can be long, so book as soon as you have an admission letter.

title: Secure accommodation
why: Student housing is scarce in most German cities, so start early.
